WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

4. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.

5. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

7. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

8. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

10. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.

11. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.

12. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Manufactured boards and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Finishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Project activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

6. C — Information and Communication Technology

9. C — CPU

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
